why.chassis-light: A lighter body needs less force to speed up, and it floats more easily.
why.chassis-standard: The middle choice: not too heavy to accelerate, not too light to push through a crowd.
why.chassis-heavy: A heavier body is harder to push around and to speed up, but harder for a hit to shove.
why.wheels-smooth: Smooth wheels roll easily, but they grip the least when turning.
why.wheels-all-terrain: All-terrain wheels are the middle choice: fair rolling and fair grip.
why.wheels-spiked: Spiked wheels grip the most when turning, but they roll harder and add mass.
why.motor-small: A small motor is light and fast at the top, but it pushes with less force.
why.motor-medium: The medium motor balances push and top speed.
why.motor-large: A large motor pushes hardest, but it is heavier and tops out slower.
